item.text: I’ll inspect the Eta configuration’s input format and point-generation limits, then create the required chunked input files and `outcome.json` without building or running EXCLURAD.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && rg --files eta | sort && printf '\\n--- README ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' eta/README.md && printf '\\n--- template ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' eta/input.dat && printf '\\n--- source input handling ---\\n' && rg -n \"READ|NPOINT|POINT|PHI|W|Q2|THETA|input.dat|IEND|MAX\" eta/exclurad.F eta/fint.F eta/*.inc eta/Makefile"

item.text: The Eta reader accepts the four kinematic arrays as whitespace-delimited blocks, and the documented operational limit is 10 points per input chunk. I’ll therefore make three chunks (10 + 10 + 5), using an inclusive φ* grid with spacing \(345/24 = 14.375^\circ\); W, Q², and cos θ* remain fixed in every point.
